subject: Learning Methods
title: Spaced Review of Book Notes
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Spaced Review of Book Notes.

hook.text: He took meticulous notes on 50 books. He never looked at them again. A year later, they might as well not exist.

buildup.text: Notes without review are just archives. The value of notes is realized only when you revisit them at intervals.

discovery.text: Quarterly review of book notes takes 15 minutes per book and refreshes months of decay in a single session.

twist.text: Each review also let you connect old ideas to new things you've learned since. Cross-pollination happens during review.

climax.text: Schedule a monthly or quarterly review of your reading notes. Treat it like an appointment with your past self.

punchline.text: Review your notes or lose your books. The choice is clear.

quiz.question: What additional benefit does reviewing old book notes provide?
options: It reveals spelling errors in your notes
It connects old ideas to new things you've learned since
It reduces the need to read new books
